# A physical native header at the first caller-local helper cut

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance. Apache-2.0.

## 1. Claim and retained premises

Fix the normalized raw caller ambient N=145, and the first caller-local
right-monomial cut at raw MOVE 9896. The current source sends raw helper 236
to owner 3356 and emits the nested token proved below. Gamma is exactly one.
No product, compiler-column or later-stage wrapper is admitted by this binder.

For every canonical ordinary parent header in the domain below, the emitted
PREPARE table physically produces a separate canonical 23-field native view.
It changes exactly selected_axes, entry_start and remainder. The other 20
values, including f, are unchanged. The parent is preserved. The RELEASE
table restores origins and erases all newly visited private body cells. The
two tables use 39 fixed private ports and at most 1000E+10000 local instructions,
where E is the physical parent-header bit length. They do not decode any
runtime shape into a host integer. Historical backing remains allocated and
is charged separately.

At the inherited normalized helper placement, this is exactly the header
required by the published current-format nine-variable Gaussian monomial.
`NativeEntrance.run` invokes that unchanged service on the original owner
field, then retires the view. Its complete relative invoice is the source
placement cost, the inherited native cost, and the new linear metadata cost.

The source placement/native contact theorem, valid global parent metadata,
disjoint physical storage, complete signed numeric format/common grid,
phase-specific headroom, and the native supplier's endpoint/time/backing
contracts remain premises. Accepting a `Route` value does not establish a
physical permutation. The exact first-helper placement is inherited from
#6878, not inferred from token syntax or tested payload values.

The selected result remains #6030, kappa 781451/250000000. All five assumptions
remain. This is neither a full selected compiler/Fourier caller nor a complete
atomic MOVE triple, and is not a new phase algebra theorem.

Every computational predecessor byte is authenticated before import.

#6878, commit `41febf890fbbb852c6059d4c0cc8c593ae9dfa5c`, already constructs the

265 audit coordinates to 145 active coordinates. The base nine survive first,

`source_binding.source_boundary` executes the actual authenticated
`current_caller` construction until it computes the desired emitted event.
Instrumentation delegates every remap to the unchanged original and stops
after observing this prefix; it does not substitute event semantics. The raw
source record is `['MOVE',236,3,7,False]` at index 9896. Its local token is

```python
('move-in','local',9896,('MOVE',236,3,7,False))
```

The actual first controller LOCAL has site 0, stage 0. Of the 562 helper labels,
raw 236 is ordinal 28, and the actual source map sends it to 32*104+28=3356.
There are 799 mapped local labels. The actual event is

```python
Event('SERVICE', (3356,),
      ('caller-local',0,0,
       ('move-in','local',9896,('MOVE',236,3,7,False))), 0)
```

This nesting follows from `context+(event.token,)` in the source remap. The
predecessor's raw/flat-prefix guard does not accept it. Our binder matches
the exact Event type and every typed field against the observed event, then
passes the same actual owner with the established raw token to the unchanged
service. Boolean 0/1 aliases, another owner, a flat token, extra nesting,
another source frame or PAID/exit cut all reject before native construction.
This is a designated-child source binding, not recursive tuple searching.

Raw helper 236 starts at empty frame 3 and finishes at rank-nine frame 127.
The selected right monomial has nine address variables and constant phase 1;
the intervening paid job has rank one. The monomial variable dimension must
not be confused with the paid rank. The source's actual source-frame and
phase interpretation are inherited; the prefix witness does not audit the
whole numerical caller.

## 3. Parent domain and complete 23-field view

Write C=outer, R=rows, a=within_bits, b=record_bits, J=row_bits. The admitted
ordinary parent has positive f,K,G,H,C,R,b,J, legal stock, and

\[
e=145f+r\le d,\quad0\le r<145,\quad
z=s+rK,\quad s\ge2H,\quad
\mathrm{back}\ge s+eK,\quad a\ge\mathrm{back}+H,
\quad J=b2^a,\quad0\le\rho<K.
\]

Here s is entry_start and z is active_start. The admitted parent reservations
imply `(f-1)G<=H`; the remaining global precision/layout/cutoff conventions
are retained as supplied. The table validates canonical binary syntax and
positive f. It does not certify all these numerical/global relations from
arbitrary user-provided metadata. The unchanged ordinary source function
`derive_geometry(145,child=False)` produces f,r,z from e,s,K, and one physical
fixture passes its actual output port directly to the new producer.

The source route premise exposes the helper's vectors at within-row positions

\[
z+(if+j)K+\rho,\qquad0\le i<9,\quad0\le j<f.
\]

These are base-nine positions before the first helper stage route. All other
bits and fields remain arbitrary complete spectators. The new view is:

| Field | Value and obligation |
|---|---|
| outer | C, unchanged complete outer multiplicity |
| rows | R, unchanged complete row count |
| stock | unchanged; this is no ordinary recursive row child |
| row_bits | J, unchanged complete physical row extent |
| within_bits | a, unchanged full address extent |
| record_bits | b, unchanged complete signed numeric record |
| p | unchanged global precision parameter |
| d | unchanged global ordinary-width budget |
| K | unchanged chunk width |
| G | unchanged reservation unit |
| H | unchanged complete front/back reservation |
| q0 | unchanged original within-row origin convention |
| qF | unchanged global front parameter |
| qB | unchanged global back parameter |
| D | unchanged global layout/reservation parameter |
| f | unchanged, since gamma=1 |
| rho | unchanged current left-counted selected bit |
| active_start | z, unchanged |
| back_start | unchanged physical back-field origin |
| selected_axes | 9f |
| entry_start | z |
| remainder | 0 |
| cutoff | unchanged global stopping parameter, unused by native view |

The new local ordinary-looking relation is `9f=9*f+0`, but the view is only
for the native monomial. It must not be passed into ordinary recursion. The
original parent remains the descriptor for all ordinary continuation and
global selected-XOR routes. There is no second subtraction of q0*K.

The old r remainder chunks are still before z; the other 136f active chunks
are after the nine vectors. Neither is projected away or assumed zero. The
new after interval is nonnegative since

\[
\mathrm{back}-z-9fK
\ge (145-9)fK\ge0.
\]

The native active width 9f is at most d. Its before interval z-2H is
nonnegative, its compact reservation t=(f-1)G is at most H, and its complete
back tail a-back is at least H. Hence every current-format layout guard
needed by the predecessor follows from this parent domain.

For clarity, the unchanged native decomposition is two front fields of total
width 2H, before width z-2H, nine vectors each of width fK, after width
back-z-9fK, and live back prefix t. These sum to back+t. The remaining
a-back-t bits are folded into additional coefficient fields by the existing
paid adapter. If each record has u complex coefficient fields, it exposes
u*2^(a-back-t) fields in this decomposition. Multiplying by the remaining
address count 2^(back+t) and by C*R gives the original complete multiplicity
C*R*u*2^a. No numeric coefficient or spectator is omitted. The new tables do
not traverse or rewrite numeric payloads, and cannot change their grid or h.

## 4. Literal physical program and all-size correctness

The descriptor alphabet is physical 0/1, LEFT 2 at the cell before its local
origin, and BLANK 6 at the frontier. This is the current raw binary descriptor
ABI, distinct from three-bit numeric CodedPort codewords. Each of the 23 fields
is `1^ell 0` followed by ell least-significant-first digits; ell>=1 and the
binary number is canonical. The total physical body length is

\[
E=2\sum_{i=1}^{23}\ell_i+23.
\]

Physical roles 0..39 are fixed. Role 13 is the borrowed parent; role 14 is the
private view. The other 38 roles are private field/length/work ports. Every
private body starts blank at its marked origin. The table contains only
local read, local write, unit move, fixed goto and done/reject/quarantine
states. `validate_tables` checks this vocabulary and forbids every parent or
marker write. Read/write/move operates on one selected local cell; the fixed
PC and finite instruction operands are not shape counters.

PREPARE first checks the local boundaries and blank work frontiers. The
unchanged fixed-schema decoder copies each actual binary value to its fixed
field port, verifies canonical digits, and restores the parent origin. It
stores the unary length on a private guide and traverses only that physical
guide; no numerical ell is decoded into host control.

The only new arithmetic use is the retained `multiply_constant(f,e,9)` table.
Its carry is in 0..8. On source bit x, it emits `(9*x+carry)%2` and changes the
finite carry to `floor((9*x+carry)/2)`. Induction on the processed low bits
proves the exact product. Its final carry uses at most four fixed digits.
Copying z into entry and writing canonical zero into remainder prove the
other two changed values. The twenty remaining field ports are unchanged.

The retained encoder writes exactly the canonical 23-field sequence to the
fresh view. All field ports are cleared. At return, only the view is live;
the parent and every private port are at origin. Thus the encoded endpoint
holds for every finite digit length, not merely the tested shapes.

`HeaderView.context` exposes role 14 through the existing read-only
BinaryContextPort. The real production `NativeEntrance` binds the original
complete owner 3356 field and separate native work bank to the unchanged
published Service, and calls its run method. It uses no numerical callback.
The local view is retired in a finally block. The inherited native field
endpoint, format, headroom and named-error guarantees remain unchanged; the
new wrapper does not strengthen its atomicity or arbitrary-error recovery.

RELEASE rewinds and clears each private body's current contiguous 0/1 prefix,
then restores the parent origin. It never searches for a stored historical
high-water address. Internal physical blanks cannot occur in a successful
encoded view or private number. During clearing, any temporary gap is created
only by that local clearing loop, which then completes before return. No
claim covers interrupted execution or a foreign corrupt physical alphabet.
The tested f=0/canonical-binary failures also leave private contiguous bodies
that this release graph safely erases.

Physical disjointness and correct origin markers are caller premises.
Object-identity checks reject obvious aliases; they are not a proof that
arbitrary custom port objects denote disjoint underlying physical segments.

## 5. Complete time and retained-backing charge

Put L=sum ell_i and let E' be the view length. Since e>=145f>=9f, the product
field has no more digits than the old selected_axes. The zero remainder has
one digit. Only replacing entry by z can increase the total digit length.
Thus L'<=L+ell_z<=2L and

\[
E'=E+2(\ell_{9f}-\ell_e)+2(\ell_z-\ell_s)+2(1-\ell_r)
\le E+2\ell_z<2E.
\]

The following deliberately loose local-instruction bounds follow directly
by expanding the unchanged Builder methods. Length n means a canonical
binary body of n digits. All endpoints are at the stated origin/frontier.
Fixed label declarations emit no runtime instruction.

| Operation | Sufficient instruction bound |
|---|---:|
| Rewind from a frontier n cells after origin | 3n+5 |
| Rewind from origin | 5 |
| Clear an n-digit body from origin | 7n+11 |
| Canonical binary check and return | 20n+20 |
| Copy n digits to a fresh role, both origins restored | 11n+12 |
| Multiply a positive n-digit source by fixed 9 | 31n+53 |
| Decode all 23 fields, restore parent, clear length guide | 27E+1064 |
| Encode 23 fields of total view length E' | 21E'+788 |

For example, decoding one field emits at most 48n+46 instructions: it copies
the unary length, scans its physical guide while copying digits, validates
the copied number, and clears the guide. The complete parent rewind adds
at most 3E+5. This gives the displayed aggregate decoder bound. Each table
transition inspected in these estimates is a local instruction, including
fixed gotos; the estimates do not count an entire scan as a single action.

Boundary and empty-work checks use 159 instructions. Combine the table above
for the initial f check, multiplication, three clears, z copy, one zero
write, final field clears and terminal state. PREPARE is bounded by
111E+2400. RELEASE is bounded by 10E'+435<=20E+435, allowing its read-only
native borrower to leave the view head anywhere within the current body.
For the admitted origin-return endpoint the sharper 7E'+435 also holds. Thus

\[
T_{metadata}\le131E+2835\le1000E+10000.
\]

The registered checker uses the latter conservative ceiling. Every physical
read, write or unit move is one of these instructions, so the physical-action
count is no larger. The bound includes the full parent/view traversals,
canonical syntax checks, fixed-constant arithmetic, setup of each call,
native-boundary origin restoration and erasure.

The program has 2742 prepare and 475 release rows, 3217 in total, and 39 fixed
private ports. Source authentication, constructing these fixed tables,
source-prefix binding, native construction and fixed port reservation carry
fixed-template setup/storage constants C0 and B0. They are not a free
input-dependent compiler, external value oracle or numerical service. With
the source geometry and native work included, the complete relative invoice
is

\[
T_{join}\le C_0+T_{source\ routes}+T_{native}(V,h,\ldots,E')
                         +1000E+10000.
\]

Keep all predecessor native setup/control/format/cleanup terms, including its
polynomial header term and historical ordinary tariff. Substituting E'<2E
changes fixed constants only; it does not turn that tariff into the selected
BIT bound. At this first helper cut, no new permutation is emitted: the
already-normalized base-nine premise is used. Entry/return work of an
enclosing normalization belongs to T_source routes. A different cut cannot
borrow this zero-new-route fact, or replace a non-permutation monomial by a
coordinate-permutation price.

At the native call boundary, only the new view is nonblank in this metadata
bank, so its live body volume is E'<2E. During preparation the decoded field
bodies and the in-progress encoding occupy O(E) cells; a safe fresh-call
bound is 5E+80 body/frontier cells, in addition to the supplied origin prefixes.
The parent is an additional borrowed E-bit body. The native bank and numeric
field retain their full inherited storage bills.

Erasure does not deallocate backing. Across a history, let M=max(E_j), and
Q=39. Each metadata role has a fixed origin and can grow to at most 2M+1
body/frontier cells. Therefore the bank's retained backing is bounded by its
initial supplied prefix backing plus Q(2M+1), together with fixed B0. This
conservative sum allows different field roles to reach their maxima on
different calls. The charged total also includes the native bank's retained
backing and the caller's parked ancestors. A later short call traverses its
current prefixes because all previously used tail cells are physically blank;
it does not scan to M. The large-then-small fixtures test precisely that
difference between current time and historical storage.

## 6. Evidence and limitations

The descriptor verifier executes 18 ordinary local-layout cases with f=1,2,5
and remainders 0,1,8,9,13,144, nontrivial outer/row/stock values, selected-bit
positions and trailing spectators. Four further cases enlarge an independent
encoded shape description. It compares all 23 decoded values and all output
bytes, restores translated origins, preserves ancestor prefixes, and inspects
every private backing cell after release. A physical source-chain case uses
the unchanged ordinary geometry producer's output port directly as the new
borrowed parent. No host reload lies between those two physical programs.

For a large-then-small history the small and fresh calls both cost 47,819
physical actions, while the metadata bank retains 37,987 versus 2,973 cells.
The f=0 canonical-input rejection followed by valid retry checks the actual
producer/release path. Thirteen source controls reject wrong owners, flat or
extra nesting, bool/int ambiguities, a wrong frame/cut/stage, a changed route
order, gamma 2, another ambient and after-stage placement.

The independent reviewer uses different sparse hardware, encoders, mathematical
header oracle and finite-table interpreter. Its eight transformation cases,
history case, three actual table mutants, three malformed binary controls and
fourteen typed source/route controls are recorded separately in review/.
Normal and optimized independent receipts are byte-identical. This is a
separate implementation review by an OpenAI-assisted collaborator, not
independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

The phase fixture constructs the actual selected Service through the new
typed binder, produces its descriptor physically, and executes the unchanged
encoded phase accumulator on actual control ports at f=2. It checks inverse
phase, the repeated constant and a wrong-residue control. It uses local
H=f-1 reservations to keep the inherited setup bounded, while retaining the
complete ordinary e=145f+r metadata and its trailing spectators. It is not a
full global root reservation/precision/provider admission. The bound public
numeric port is unused by this control fixture; no fake numeric callback
supplies a result. The actual huge full monomial run and the intervening
Fourier child are not executed. Those limits appear in the machine receipt.

Neither metadata test families nor the phase fixture instantiate every
upstream global qF/qB/precision condition. The all-size endpoint is the
argument in sections 3–5 under the admitted parent/native contracts; passing
finite synthetic metadata does not establish those contracts. The new header
graphs are literal finite tables. The retained whole native implementation
remains its published source-level fixed-control refinement; this package
does not flatten that complete service into the lifecycle table format.

Concurrent local `research/current-coded-atomic-move` work, unpublished
at this scope check, addresses the raw owner 236 atomic MOVE triple, with a reduced local header.
Only its top-level atomic_move.py/check_move.py were inspected for scope.
They are not imported or presumed verified. That numeric triple is distinct
from the present actual caller-local owner 3356/header interface.
